about: Breakers Surf School is a St Agnes surf school on the north Cornish coast, with an address on Quay Road by Trevaunance Cove. It runs everything from a two-hour first lesson to multi-lesson improver courses, as well as kids' sessions, private coaching and stand-up paddleboarding, and keeps its groups small.
offers: Kids Club and Local Kids Surf Academy
